macros.name: AddToList
macros.doc: This adds the words to the ⟨name⟩ list, which of course should already exist.

macros.name: DoNotSort
macros.doc: \DoNotSort resets to default, i.e. replacement texts follow the order in which they were defined.

macros.name: NormalOutput
macros.doc: \NormalOutput restores the value of the output routine at work when \PatchOutput was executed.

macros.name: PatchTracing
macros.doc: With \PatchTracing, XESearch will try to keep quiet during those painful moments, i.e. \tracingcommands and \tracingmacros will be turned to zero.

macros.name: SearchOnlyOne
macros.doc: \SearchAll and \SearchOnlyOne sets what should happen when a word is matched by an affix: shall the search stop, or shall XESearch continue to investigate whether other affixes might fit too?
